context: Round 34 follow-up. R33 applied 5 unrelated patches (temperature+STEPs). Our 4 findings from R33 were not addressed. Re-submit for R34 with stronger specificity.

findings.title: 9 pre-existing sub-agents missing constitution-reference
findings.fix: Add `constitution: sub_mas-master-constitution.yaml` line right after `name:` line in each file

findings.title: sub_mas-pre-push-validator lacks constitution-coverage check
findings.fix: Add a check that parses all files in recipe/sub/*.yaml + recipe/sub/demo-team/*.yaml (excluding sub_mas-master-constitution.yaml itself), verifies each has `constitution: sub_mas-master-constitution.yaml` field. If any missing → FAIL with list of files.

findings.title: sub_mas-pre-push-validator is interactive (R01 confirmation) — blocks non-interactive runs
findings.fix: Add env-var check: if RECURSION_OVERRIDE>=1 OR --no-session, skip R01 confirmation and proceed with checks. Otherwise, ask for confirmation.
